| style="color:#c62828;" |DMG

| style="color:#c62828;" |Ally, Buff, DMG
| style="text-align:left; color:#c62828; padding:10px;" |Grants Flame to the caster and 3 random allieswithin 3 grids of the caster for 2 turns. This effectcannot be dispelled.
